data_scope: retrospective reconstructed diagnostic; no pristine confirmation
forecaster_metrics: reuse research.efficiency.evaluation.evaluate, 2000 block bootstrap draws, seed2302026, binary home winner Brier/log loss, margin/total MAE RMSE

probability_diagnostics.reliability: ten fixed equal-width probability bins, last includes p=1; report counts/mean p/outcome frequency

selection.risk: LOSS/(WIN+LOSS) on this full-game non-tie dataset
selection.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of full-population chronological blocks; include zero-selection blocks; percentile 95%; fixed seed2302026
selection.comparison: select-all versus each frozen threshold on each unchanged forecaster; no optimum selected
selection.operational: all forecasts lack promotion/qualification and remain BLOCKED; raw predictions retained

joint_diagnostics.scope: candidate continuous distribution only, not exact integer ATS settlement
joint_diagnostics.source: frozen pre-2025 residual covariance already in separate joint state; no refit
joint_diagnostics.baseline: no distribution comparison if original control lacks joint distribution

integrity: all rows unique exact events in declared population
rows plus stage exclusions reconcile full population
training event IDs disjoint from scored event IDs
retained forecast component receipts internally hash and chronology verified
